criteria.criterion: Before anything is written under .vloop/state/ (gate logs, session records, reports, run.log, journal), every occurrence of the value of an environment variable whose name contains KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD or CREDENTIAL (case-insensitive) and whose value is at least 8 characters is replaced with `<redacted:NAME>`.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/session.go redactSecrets (case-insensitive name regex, minSecret=8, JSON-escaped form too) is called from Runner.Mask. Mask is already applied at the existing write sites: the gate log (iterate.go:780), the journal and log lines (iterate.go:122,130, plan.go), the session stderr and record (session.go:333,343), and the reports (iterate.go:817).

criteria.criterion: Redaction keys on variable names, not value shapes; a guide under docs/guide/ says what is redacted and that a secret in an innocently named variable is not caught.
criteria.evidence: docs/guide/concepts.md gains a 'What is redacted' section that says names not values are matched, and that DB_URL or AUTH style variables and values under 8 characters are not caught.

criteria.criterion: Session records keep, per permission denial, the tool name and the file path when there is one — never the command or content — and still validate as session/v1.
criteria.evidence: session.go record() rebuilds each denial as {tool_name, file_path?} from file_path or notebook_path. TestSessionDenialsKeepToolAndPath asserts the exact kept shape and that the content and command strings are absent. The gate validates the record as session/v1.

criteria.criterion: Tests TestRedactSecretEnvValues and TestSessionDenialsKeepToolAndPath in internal/driver and TestRunGateLogRedacted in cmd/vloop/run_redact_test.go (verify `env` with FOO_TOKEN=s3cr3t-value: the log holds <redacted:FOO_TOKEN>, not the value) fail against the base.
criteria.evidence: All three tests exist with real assertions. TestRedactSecretEnvValues covers redaction, the short-value exception, case-insensitive names and a JSON-quoted value. TestRunGateLogRedacted runs the real `env` gate, checks the redaction marker, checks that the 7-character SHORT_KEY stays, and checks via git log that the value is not committed. They cannot pass on the base, which has no redaction and keeps raw denials.

notes: I did not re-run the tests myself; I relied on the driver's gate run. The pre-existing TestSessionMasking was edited to feed denials in the new tool_name/tool_input shape and to expect `"~/f"`. That follows from the required denial-shape change and is not a goalpost move. Redaction is exact-value matching, so an env value that is a substring of other text is also replaced, which the brief accepts.
